REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagrnahal St., Diliman Quezon City OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY DILG Legal Opinion No. 05, S. 2013 19 FEB MR. FLORENCIO B. QUICOY, JR. Department Head Land Bank of the Philippines Antipolo Branch M.L. Quezon St., Antipolo City BARANGAY SAN LUIS, ANTIPOLO CITY PUNONG BARANGAY CONTROVERSY Dear Mr. Quicoy, Jr.: This refers to your request for clarification on this Department's Opinion No. 2-13, S. 2013 relative to two issues, to wit: l. Validity of the Decision dated 02 January 2013 of the Sangguniang Panlungsod imposing upon you the penalty of suspension for six (6) months; and 2. Whether the aforesaid Decision may be implemented even before the lapse of the fifteen (15)-day period provided under Antipolo City Ordinance No. 94- 2001. As regards the first issue, please note that this Department deliberately did not address the same since as we have stated: "the Department will not unduly intervene on an issue which is within the jurisdiction of another body" since it appears that there was an appeal of the decision of the Sangguniang Panlungsod. Hence, there is nothing to be clarified anent this issue. With respect to the second issue, please be advised that this Department resolved the same by clarifying that the implementation of the SP Decision should be made in the light of the City Ordinance, the latter having been stated in the opinion to be presumed valid. Since the Department's Legal Opinion had presumed the validity of the City Ordinance anent the enforceability of the Decision stated above, then we have effectively declared that the implementation Of the Decision of the SP should comply with the period provided in the ordinance. Therefore, the recognition made by Antipolo City Mayor Danilo Leyble in favor of PB Andrei Zapanta on 7 January 2013 finds basis in the said City Ordinance. At this juncture, the fact that the election period (January 13 to June 12, 2013) has set-in within the fifteen-day period provided by the ordinance for the enforceability of the SP Decision, then it becomes incumbent upon the SP to seek the opinion of' the COMELEC

as to whether or not the latter's clearance should be a condition precedent for the implementation of the said Decision in the light of Section 1 (A)(2) of COMELEC Resolution No. 9581 dared December 18, 2012 entitled: "IN THE MATTER OF ENFORCING THE PROHIBITIONS AGAINST APPOINTMENT OR HIRING OF NEW EMPLOYEES, CREATING OR FILLING OF NEW POSITIONS, GIVING ANY SALARY INCREASE OR TRANSFERRING OR DETAILING ANY OFFICER OR EMPLOYEE IN THE CIVIL SERVICE AND SUSPENSION OF ELECTIVE LOCAL OFFICIALS IN CONNECTION WITH THE MAY 13, 2013 AUTOMATED SYNCHORIZED NATIONAL, LOCAL AND ARNIM REGIONAL ELECTIONS", which provides, to wit: "Section I. Prohibited acts. B. Suspend any elective provincial, city, municipal or barangay officer, unless the suspension will be for purposes of applying the "Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act" in relation to the suspension and removal of elective officials." Attached is a copy of the said COMELEC Resolution for your ready reference. Hence, if you are raising the issue of recognition between PB Zapanta and Mr. Cate, you are hereby advised to raise the same before the COMELEC, in view of the provisions stated above. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary
